The Mask of Terror is a human member of  Auntie Ethel's flock. He is in the Overgrown Tunnel inside the Riverside Teahouse / Gnarled Teahouse in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Like the other Masks, the Mask of Terror is initially hostile by virtue of wearing a  Whispering Mask, placing him under the  Charming effect of  Part of the Flock.

If he is encountered after Ethel is dead, he is no longer hostile, but his sanity is gone. He remains hostile if Ethel is defeated but the party accept the offer of  Hag's Hair and let Ethel escape.

Combat

Attacks and actions

Mask of Terror must succeed a  DC 17 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of each of his turns or become affected by  Hag's Pawn. If he succeeds the save, he passes his turn without harming the party.
